_comment: Lightning Phases 6 and 7, the matcher. NOT YET APPLIED: every name below is a promise until the owner installs 20260926080332 after the four remediation-two files 20260926072527 to 20260926072638. fn_lightning_config(cluster) is every matcher tunable from cash_games.ruleset_snapshot -> 'lightning' with defaults, type checks and clamps, a bad value reported under invalid, thresholds from fn_cash_cluster_lightning_thresholds (fn_lightning_config_number is its number reader). fn_lightning_player_legality(cluster, now, disconnected) is P0: one first-failing reason per open pool session from one ordered CASE, reusing fn_lightning_anchor_is_live_eligible, fn_lightning_pool_stack, fn_lightning_player_in_hand, fn_platform_frozen, fn_ca_player_restricted gated by ca_operator_policy.restrictions_enforced, and fn_rg_require_not_excluded. fn_lightning_group_sizes is P1's arithmetic. fn_lightning_match(cluster, now, disconnected, version) plans (STABLE, writes nothing) through fn_lightning_match_plan, which fn_lightning_match_and_form(cluster, now, disconnected, max_hands, request_id) also calls with its own capacity before forming each group through fn_lightning_form_hand; the writer records matcher_assignment and matcher_pass in cash_cluster_events and the pass in the new append-only cash_cluster_matcher_pass, keyed by request id. lightning_pool_slot gains idle_since (P4's first key), kept by trg_matcher_slot_idle_since_starts_at_open and trg_matcher_reservation_end_marks_the_slot_idle. lightning_reservation_active_by_player serves the multi-table count. Nothing is wired into a tick; every function is executable by service_role only.
